ios.desc:
Your whole week on one screen. Tap a cell the day you actually did it — that's the whole routine.
THRIVE is a habit and goal tracker that looks like a 1983 phosphor terminal: six life stats, XP, streaks and shields, every pixel drawn in code.
No account, no ads, no analytics. Nothing ever leaves your iPhone.
T.H.R.I.V.E. — YOUR SIX STATS
• T — Training: sport, diet, sleep
• H — Head: reading, study, languages
• R — Relations: family, friends, staying in touch
• I — Inner: meditation, journaling, gratitude
• V — Value: budget, career, investments
• E — Expression: music, writing, any craft
HOW IT WORKS
• Check-ins & XP: every check-in grants XP twice — to the goal's stat and to your overall level.
• Stat levels pay off: the higher a stat, the more XP each of its check-ins gives.
• Weekly streak bonus: close every scheduled day of the week and Monday brings a bonus; consecutive weeks multiply it.
• Decay: a stat idle for 7 days starts fading — one check-in stops it.
• Shields: a shield covers a missed day so it doesn't break your streak.
• Ranks: every 10 levels opens a new tier with a new rank insignia.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no feed, no ads, no analytics. Everything lives on your device — we couldn't see your data if we wanted to.
PRICING
Every feature is free for 14 days — no sign-up, no card. After the trial your data stays visible; keep checking in with a monthly or yearly subscription, or a one-time lifetime purchase.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
